summary: Schneider National filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary Schneider Receivables Corporation entered into Amendment No. 7 to its Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement on September 30, 2026. The amendment increases available commitments on the $400 million secured accounts receivable facility from $200 million to $400 million, raises the letter of credit sublimit from $150 million to $250 million, extends the scheduled termination date to September 28, 2029, and loosens trade receivable eligibility criteria. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply. Watch covenant headroom and SOFR-based borrowing costs.
